comments.author: yehudalouis
comments.story: Ten Percent of the Brain Myth
comments.text: "They say 3% of people use 5-6% of their brains, 97% use just 3% and the rest goes down the drain... I'll never know which one I am, but I'll bet you my last dime, 99% think we're 3%, 100% of the time." -- Statistician's Blues, Todd Snider. [VIDEO]
